# `uname` for [system](/commands/categories/system.md)

<div class='command-title'>Print certain system information using uutils&#x2f;coreutils uname.</div>

## Signature

```> uname {flags} ```


## Input/output types:

| input   | output                                                                                                                                   |
| ------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| nothing | record&lt;kernel-name: string, nodename: string, kernel-release: string, kernel-version: string, machine: string, operating-system: string&gt; |
## Examples

Print all information
```nu

```
